steps.title: Quantify input DNA
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer for high‑quality DNA or the KAPA hgDNA Quantification and QC Kit for FFPE DNA.

steps.title: Remove EDTA from samples
steps.instruction: If samples contain EDTA, perform a 3× bead‑based cleanup with KAPA cleanup beads (see Technical Data Sheet KR1705 or KR1245). If the presence or concentration of EDTA is unknown, first purify the DNA by column‑ or bead‑based cleanup or buffer exchange before fragmentation.

steps.title: Dilute DNA to target volume
steps.instruction: Dilute 100 ng of each DNA sample into 30 µL TE buffer (≈3.33 ng/µL). After later dilution to 50 µL for fragmentation, the final EDTA concentration will be 0.6 mM (calculated as 1 mM × 30 µL / 50 µL).

steps.title: Prepare diluted Conditioning Solution
steps.instruction: Make a 2.2‑fold dilution of the Conditioning Solution as described in Table 3 of the Library Construction Protocol and keep it ready for the fragmentation reactions.

steps.title: Set up test fragmentation reactions
steps.instruction: Create a series of test reactions using the same amount of input DNA and varying final concentrations of the diluted Conditioning Solution; include at least one reaction with EDTA‑free control DNA of comparable type and quality.

steps.title: Fragment DNA and complete libraries
steps.instruction: Fragment each reaction using the enzymatic fragmentation parameters from the Library Construction Protocol (step 1), then finish the library construction workflow for all test and control samples.

steps.title: Analyze library size distributions
steps.instruction: Run the completed libraries on an electrophoretic system and compare the size distributions of test samples to the EDTA‑free control.

steps.title: Iteratively titrate Conditioning concentration
steps.instruction: Begin with 3–4 test reactions covering a broad range of Conditioning Solution concentrations, evaluate the fragmentation profiles, and then perform a finer titration over a narrower range until test samples match the control or achieve the desired library size distribution.
